name: the harness loads iro and pako from their CDNs again
why: Points addRequiredLibs() back at cdn.jsdelivr.net / cdnjs.cloudflare.com, as before 2026-10-04. With both hosts unreachable the page load fails in addScriptTag, which is what failed 72 tests of the 9.99.1215 merge gate.

edits.find:
await page.addScriptTag({ path: IRO_PATH });
    await page.addScriptTag({ path: PAKO_PATH });
edits.replace:
await page.addScriptTag({ url: 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@jaames/iro@5' });
    await page.addScriptTag({ url: 'https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/pako/2.1.0/pako.min.js' });
